description: This file provides client-side functions to interact with a backend API, including retrieving the base URL, making authenticated API requests, performing health checks, and a mock login function. It handles JSON parsing and manages authorization headers based on session state.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the backend API base URL, configurable via environment variable or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers } = {})
methods.description: Performs an API request with support for method, body, headers, authorization, and JSON response parsing.

methods.name: healthCheck()
methods.description: Checks backend health by making a GET request to the root endpoint.

methods.name: loginMock({ email })
methods.description: Provides a mock login response with a static token and user info, for demo purposes.

ctags.name: apiRequest
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiRequest(path, { method = "GET", body, headers } = {}) {$/
